title: The Most Reasonable Explanation — EN/DE/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan male vocal English German French language learning dry wit
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, measured pace]
My neighbour's fence was fine last Tuesday
By Thursday morning it had fallen
I sat down with a cup of tea
And thought this through from start to end

[Verse 1 - English]
I considered wind, I considered rain
I considered the structural integrity of the bend
And I arrived at a conclusion
After careful and deliberate thought
The most reasonable explanation
Is not the one that first appears

[Verse 2 - Deutsch]
Ich habe den Wind in Betracht gezogen
(I considered the wind)
Ich habe den Regen in Betracht gezogen
(I considered the rain)
Ich habe die strukturelle Integrität untersucht
(I examined the structural integrity)
Und ich kam zu einem Schluss
(And I arrived at a conclusion)
Die vernünftigste Erklärung
(The most reasonable explanation)
Ist nicht die offensichtlichste
(Is not the most obvious one)

[Chorus - Français]
L'explication la plus raisonnable
(The most reasonable explanation)
Après une réflexion soigneuse et délibérée
(After careful and deliberate thought)
C'est que quelque chose de très déterminé
(Is that something of considerable determination)
A poussé cette clôture
(Pushed that fence down)
L'explication la plus raisonnable
(The most reasonable explanation)
N'est jamais la première
(Is never the first one)
Parfois il faut quatre à six ans
(Sometimes it takes four to six years)

[Bridge - spoken, all three]
Margaret reversed her car into it on Wednesday evening
Margarete fuhr mit ihrem Auto dagegen am Mittwochabend
Margaret a reculé sa voiture contre elle mercredi soir
Too obvious
Zu offensichtlich
Trop évident

[Outro]
The most reasonable explanation was confirmed
Die vernünftigste Erklärung wurde bestätigt
L'explication la plus raisonnable a été confirmée
